name: Inngest
description: Event-driven workflow platform. Monitor function deployment and event access.

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Inngest Cloud (https://app.inngest.com).
2. Select the environment you want to monitor (Production or a branch env).
3. Go to Manage > Signing Key and copy the value (starts with "signkey-").
4. Paste the signing key above and save.
Note: Inngest does not provide a public REST endpoint for listing team members, so the employee-access check is informational only and asks you to perform a manual review in the Inngest dashboard.
